jobs.api_description_text:
Job Overview

We are looking for a curious and hands-on AI Engineer to build, deploy, and operate AI solutions for enterprise customers in regulated industries. In this role, you will build AI agents and LLM-powered applications, connect them to enterprise data and systems, and take them from prototype to production on on-premise infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer with strong applied AI skills who enjoys solving real business problems. You should be comfortable understanding a problem, designing an agent-based or LLM-driven solution, and deploying it to run reliably in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Problem Understanding: Understand business problems, clarify requirements and success criteria, and propose a practical AI-driven approach.

  • Agent Development: Build and configure AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning and tool use, using agent harnesses and frameworks.

  • Tools & MCP Integration: Build custom tools, skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let agents interact with APIs, databases and internal systems.

  • Applied AI & RAG: Build LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines. Optimise prompts, retrieval and context to improve the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

  • Evaluation & Optimisation: Test and evaluate agent and LLM outputs, then improve accuracy, latency and cost across models and workflows.

  • Deployment & Operations: Deploy and operate models and AI services on on-premise infrastructure using Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues and keep services reliable.

  • Data Integration: Connect data sources, build data pipelines, and prepare data for retrieval, analytics and AI use cases.

  • Delivery Ownership: Own assigned workstreams from proof-of-concept to production: plan tasks, manage timelines and flag risks early.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI, IT or a related field. (Fresh graduates to 3 years of experience; high-potential fresh graduates are welcome.)

  • Applied AI: Hands-on experience building with LLMs through final year projects, internships, side projects or hackathons, with a working understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG and AI agents.

  • Programming: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go or TypeScript (Node.js), with Git for version control.

  • Linux & Containers: Solid working knowledge of Linux environments (CLI) and hands-on experience containerising and running applications with Docker.

  • Ownership: Takes ownership of problems end to end, from understanding the need to delivering a working result, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Language: Proficient in written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Production AI Delivery: Experience delivering production-ready AI projects across the full software development life cycle (SDLC), from design and development through testing and deployment.

  • Agent Frameworks & MCP: Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, and building MCP servers.

  • RAG Pipelines: Familiarity with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases and rerankers.

  • Model Serving: Experience with vLLM, Ollama or similar model-serving tools.

  • Orchestration: Exposure to Kubernetes or deployments in on-premise / private cloud environments.

  • Data: SQL skills and experience building data pipelines.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Able to explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders, present demos and gather requirements.

jobs.api_description_text:
About SleekFlow

SleekFlow is an AI Suite for Revenue-Driving Conversations. We are trusted by over 2,000 enterprises globally. But we are more than just a SaaS company; we are an AI-native movement redefining the B2C relationship across 70+ countries.


At our core is AgentFlow—an AI GTM workforce that learns, improves, and acts as a self-healing knowledge base for businesses. From first-click conversion to long-term retention, we turn every conversation into a data-backed growth opportunity. Headquartered in Singapore with a global presence in Hong Kong, the UAE, and the US, we are looking for exceptional people to help us build an AI operating system that matters.


Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.


Learn more from our blogs for developers: https://sleekflow.io/blog/category/developer-blog


Mid-Level

Location: Malaysia

Minimum Experience: 1~2 years of experience working with RAG/LLM development and deployment

Language: Fluency in English is required


Role

We are seeking a highly skilled LLM/RAG/Multi-Agent Infrastructure Engineer to design, develop, and optimize infrastructure for integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via APIs, building efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and enabling multi-agent frameworks. You will work at the intersection of AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and automation to create high-performance, scalable solutions that power next-generation AI-driven applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • LLM Evaluation: Assess the strengths and limitations of various LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) to determine the best fit for specific applications and use cases.
  • RAG Pipeline Engineering: Develop and scale RAG architectures, integrating vector databases, retrieval mechanisms, and embedding models for efficient knowledge retrieval.
  • Multi-Agent Coordination: Design robust infrastructure to support multi-agent interactions, enabling efficient message passing, distributed decision-making, and autonomous collaboration.
  • Knowledge Base Development: Design and implement structured knowledge bases that enhance LLM output quality by integrating domain-specific data, ontologies, and automated document indexing.
  • Databases & Storage: Use vector databases, NoSQL databases, and caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch) to support efficient knowledge retrieval and AI workloads.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Establish logging, monitoring, and tracing systems for API performance, system health, and anomaly detection.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure best practices for data privacy, security, and compliance in AI deployments.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, and software developers to integrate AI models into production environments effectively.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM APIs & RAG: Hands-on experience in integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) and building RAG pipelines with vector search (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone).
  • Multi-Agent Frameworks: Familiarity with multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) and their infrastructure requirements.
  • Knowledge Base Engineering: Experience in designing, indexing, and maintaining structured and unstructured knowledge bases, including knowledge graph construction, ontology design, and text embedding techniques.
  • CI/CD & MLOps: Experience with ML model versioning, deployment pipelines, and monitoring tools.
  • Prompt Engineering Expertise: Proficiency in designing clear, structured prompts, optimizing AI responses through iterative refinement, and leveraging advanced techniques like few-shot learning and chain-of-thought reasoning for improved accuracy and coherence.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in AI infrastructure for high-traffic SaaS or enterprise AI applications.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and agent-based AI systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, Ray, or similar).
  • Experience in leveraging structured and semi-structured data for improving LLM-generated outputs.


Our Culture Code

  • Open-mindedness – We welcome different viewpoints and give and take feedback openly, always ready to challenge our own assumptions.
  • Collaboration – We have each other's back, share knowledge freely, and treat every teammate with equal respect.
  • Growth – We pursue continuous improvement, embrace new challenges, and treat mistakes as chances to learn.
  • Ownership – We take initiative, see things through, and hold ourselves accountable for the outcome.
  • Grit & Adaptability – We stay resilient through setbacks and adapt to change with patience and persistence.


What We Offer:

  • Attractive compensation package, including a 13th-month salary.
  • Stock options in a rapidly growing startup.
  • A fun, diverse, and international team culture.
  • Comprehensive group medical insurance.
  • Transport allowance.
  • Examination & education allowance.
  • Paid birthday leave.
  • Flexible work-from-home policy.
  • “Work From Anywhere” scheme.
  • Rewarding continuous learning from experienced team leads.
  • Many more exciting perks and growth opportunities!


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

About ThoughtFull

ThoughtFull is on a mission to simplify mental health for your personal and professional growth - through every season of life, anytime, anywhere.

ThoughtFull is a Temasek-backed mental health company that provides full mental healthcare services for corporates clients around the Asian region and beyond. We were the first in Asia to offer clinically validated text-based coaching and the first to partner with insurers, making care more accessible to individuals and businesses. Join us on our mission and be part of our rockstar team!

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, secure, and production-ready AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern AI frameworks.
  • Build AI agents and automated workflows that integrate with APIs, databases, tools, and existing systems to enhance product capabilities and operational efficiency.
  • Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document processing, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval strategies.
  • Integrate and manage LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and AWS Bedrock, utilizing prompt engineering, structured outputs, and function calling.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs to support AI-powered applications and integrations.
  • Implement AI evaluation frameworks and guardrails to ensure accuracy, consistency, safety, reliability, and protection of sensitive data, including appropriate human escalation mechanisms.

  • Deploy, monitor, and maintain AI services using cloud infrastructure, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements


About you

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including practical experience building AI/LLM applications.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend development frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers.
  • Experience building production-oriented LLM applications using prompting, structured outputs, and tool/function calling.

  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, retrieval techniques, and vector databases such as pgvctor, Pinecone, Milvus, or similar.

  • Experience designing RESTful APIs, integrating databases, and developing backend services.

  • Knowledge of application security, data privacy, and responsible AI development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently deliver AI features from prototype to production.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock and cloud-native AI services.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems and AI workflow orchestration.
  • Familiarity with LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar.
  • validation.

  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data or regulated environments.
  • Experience developing AI solutions for healthcare, mental health, or personalized recommendation systems.


IMPORTANT NOTE:

Who We Are

The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC) is the world's largest beverage company, refreshing consumers worldwide for over 135 years. Our unrivaled portfolio includes more than 500 sparkling and still brands and more than 3,800 beverage choices, with iconic brands such as Coca-Cola, Sprite, Minute Maid, Schweppes, FuzeTea, Monster, and Fanta.


With over 1,500 employees, Coca-Cola Beverages Singapore, Malaysia & Brunei is a complex and well-developed organization that produces, sells, and distributes the Coca-Cola Company products across the country. Our world-class manufacturing plant in Halal Park, Bandar Enstek in Negeri Sembilan serves as our Halal production hub for Malaysia, Singapore, and Brunei.


About The Role

Location: Menara Lien Ho, Petaling Jaya

Department: Business System

Reports to: Head of Enterprise Data, AI & Decision Intelligence


What You’ll Do

The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on developing multi-agent applications, RAG solutions, enterprise data integrations, APIs, and production-ready AI capabilities.


The role will work across the AI development lifecycle—from architecture and prototyping through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain, Azure, SQL, and Docker.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy enterprise Agentic AI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, FastAPI, and Azure.
  • Develop multi-agent workflows, including agent orchestration, routing, tool use, memory, validation, and human-in-the-loop processes.
  • Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions integrating enterprise data, documents, knowledge bases, metadata, and vector search.
  • Develop secure and scalable APIs using FastAPI and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and data platforms.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL for data retrieval, analytical reasoning, validation, and AI-generated queries.
  • Deploy and manage containerized AI applications on Azure, including Azure App Service.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support testing, deployment, versioning, and environment promotion.
  • Define and implement AI/LLM evaluation frameworks, covering areas such as accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, relevance, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Implement LLM observability and tracing using tools such as Langfuse, MLflow, or equivalent platforms.
  • Apply Responsible AI, safety guardrails, and production governance when developing and deploying AI solutions.
  • Develop or rapidly prototype user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks and AI-enabled development tools.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent patterns, and platform capabilities.


Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on Python & FastAPI development experience.
  • Strong practical experience with LangGraph & LangChain.
  • Hands-on experience building RAG, multi-agent, and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience building and deploying Agentic AI solutions, experimenting or conducting POCs.
  • Practical experience with Azure Cloud and Azure App Service.
  • Very strong SQL, including complex queries and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of Docker/containerization and production deployment.
  • Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience defining and implementing AI/LLM evaluation metrics.
  • Experience with LLM observability, such as Langfuse, MLflow, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience implementing Responsible AI, safety guardrails, and production governance.
  • Ability to develop or prototype modern frontends using AI-enabled development tools.


What You Bring

  • Approximately 5–7 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, cloud engineering, AI engineering, or related areas.
  • At least 2–3 years of hands-on experience delivering GenAI, RAG, or Agentic AI solutions.
  • Proven experience taking AI applications from prototype/POC through to secure production deployment.
  • Strong software engineering and cloud deployment capabilities.
  • Strong technical leadership and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Able to communicate effectively and work with both technical and business stakeholders


Our Purpose & Growth Behavior

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We focus on five key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive, agile, and corporate entrepreneurship – and value how we work as much as what we achieve.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. When we collect your personal information as part of a job application or offer of employment, we do so in accordance with industry standards and best practices and in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

Salary: RM 3,000 – RM 4,000 per month

Skop Tugas dan Tanggungjawab Utama

A. Pembangunan dan Pelaksanaan AI

  1. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI mengikut keperluan dan objektif perniagaan syarikat.

  2. Mereka bentuk, membina dan menguji model AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  3. Membangunkan aplikasi AI seperti chatbot, AI assistant, recommendation system dan intelligent automation.

  4. Mengintegrasikan teknologi AI dengan sistem sedia ada seperti CRM, ERP, sistem pengurusan projek dan pangkalan data syarikat.

  5. Menilai keberkesanan model AI dari segi ketepatan, kelajuan dan kebolehgunaan bagi semua Jabatan termasuk Jabatan Marketing, Sales dan sebagainya.

B. Automasi Proses Kerja (AI Automation)

  1. Mengenal pasti proses kerja manual yang boleh diautomasikan menggunakan AI.

  2. Membangunkan sistem automasi bagi mengurangkan kerja berulang dan kebergantungan kepada proses manual.

  3. Menghasilkan workflow automasi untuk jabatan Sales, Marketing, HR, Finance, QS, Procurement dan Operations.

  4. Membangunkan sistem pemprosesan dokumen secara automatik seperti quotation, invoice, laporan dan dokumen projek.

  5. Meningkatkan kecekapan proses kerja melalui integrasi AI dengan aplikasi dan platform digital.

C. AI untuk Operasi Pembinaan dan Pengurusan Projek

  1. Meneroka penggunaan AI dalam proses pembinaan rumah dan pengurusan projek ZASMA.

  2. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI untuk membantu semakan dokumen teknikal, lukisan, spesifikasi dan laporan projek.

  1. Membantu menganalisis data projek bagi mengenal pasti risiko kelewatan, pembaziran kos dan isu kualiti.

  2. Membangunkan sistem pemantauan prestasi projek berasaskan data.

D. Data Analytics dan Business Intelligence

  1. Mengumpul, membersihkan dan menganalisis data bagi menyokong pembangunan model AI.

  2. Membangunkan dashboard dan sistem pelaporan pintar untuk pihak pengurusan.

  3. Menggunakan data bagi mengenal pasti trend, corak prestasi dan peluang penambahbaikan.

  4. Menghasilkan analisis ramalan (predictive analytics) bagi membantu proses membuat keputusan.

  5. Memastikan data yang digunakan adalah tepat, relevan dan berkualiti.

E. Integrasi Sistem dan Penyelenggaraan

  1. Mengintegrasikan aplikasi AI dengan sistem dan perisian pihak ketiga melalui API.

  2. Memastikan sistem AI berfungsi dengan baik, stabil dan boleh digunakan oleh pengguna.

  3. Menjalankan troubleshooting, debugging dan penambahbaikan sistem.

  4. Melaksanakan ujian sistem sebelum sesuatu penyelesaian AI digunakan secara rasmi.

  5. Menyediakan dokumentasi teknikal, panduan penggunaan dan rekod penyelenggaraan.

F. Penyelidikan dan Inovasi Teknologi

  1. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi terkini dalam bidang AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  2. Menilai kesesuaian teknologi AI baharu untuk diaplikasikan dalam operasi syarikat.

  3. Menjalankan Proof of Concept (POC) bagi menguji idea dan penyelesaian AI.

  4. Mencadangkan inovasi digital yang boleh memberikan kelebihan daya saing kepada ZASMA.

  5. Membandingkan keberkesanan teknologi dan platform AI dari aspek kos, fungsi, keselamatan dan pulangan pelaburan.

G. Keselamatan dan Tadbir Urus AI

  1. Memastikan penggunaan AI mematuhi polisi keselamatan maklumat dan kerahsiaan syarikat.

  2. Mengawal akses kepada data dan sistem yang digunakan dalam pembangunan AI.

  3. Memastikan penyelesaian AI tidak mendedahkan maklumat sulit syarikat atau pelanggan.

  4. Menilai risiko kesilapan, bias dan ketidaktepatan output AI.

  5. Memastikan setiap penyelesaian AI mempunyai kawalan manusia (human oversight) bagi keputusan yang kritikal.

3. Pembangunan dan Kerjasama Antara Jabatan

  1. Bekerjasama dengan semua Ketua Jabatan dan Ketua Unit untuk mengenal pasti keperluan AI mengikut fungsi jabatan masing-masing.

  2. Mengadakan sesi perbincangan bersama pengguna bagi memahami masalah dan cabaran proses kerja.

  3. Memberikan latihan dan tunjuk ajar kepada staf berkaitan penggunaan sistem AI yang dibangunkan.

  4. Menjadi rujukan teknikal syarikat dalam penggunaan teknologi AI.

  5. Memastikan setiap projek AI yang dibangunkan dapat digunakan secara praktikal dan memberikan manfaat kepada pengguna.

4. KPI (Key Performance Indicators)

AI Application Engineering

  • Python Development: Build Python applications, microservices, and APIs that serve AI models and agents.

  • Deployment Support: Support deployment of AI applications to production, including basic CI/CD and containerized workflows.

  • Monitoring: Help set up monitoring and alerting for model performance and application health.

  • Research & Development: Keep current with AI/ML and agent developments; experiment with new models, frameworks, and techniques.

  • Cloud Exposure: Basic familiarity with AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure, and with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.

jobs.api_description_text:
AI Engineer - ASR: PraDigi, a Pratham Initiative

About Pratham International

Pratham International is a US 501(c)(3) established to support learning innovations for children and youth in contexts across the globe. We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham reaches approximately 7.5 million children annually across 23 Indian states and union territories and an additional 1 million across 31 countries..

Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.

The team’s innovative technology products include the Anytime Testing Model (ATM), an AI-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children’s reading fluency in Hindi and eight Indian languages; and a suite of LLM-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from BaalSakhi for early childhood care, to a skilling interview bot for youth employment readiness, and OCR-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.

At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it’s ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.

Description of the Role
Pratham International, through its wholly-owned subsidiary in India (PULS Pvt. Ltd.), is looking to hire an AI Engineer for the PraDigi Initiative.

As an ASR Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of speech recognition systems for automated reading assessment across multiple languages. The engineer will work across the full ASR pipeline: from supervising data collection, annotation, data preparation and model training to decoding, alignment, error analysis, and deployment. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of speech recognition, multilingual NLP, and educational assessment.

Key responsibilities include:

Data Collection and Annotation

  • Provide technical inputs to speech data collection design, including sampling across languages, dialects, age groups, reading levels, recording environments, devices, and target items to ensure the dataset is representative and useful for model training and evaluation.
  • Define annotation guidelines and quality checks for transcripts, reading errors, disfluencies, background speech and other phenomena relevant to reading assessment.
  • Work with data and field teams to identify data gaps and annotation inconsistencies through model error analysis, and recommend targeted additional data collection or re-annotation where needed.
  • Help design annotation schemas and inter-annotator quality processes so labels are consistent enough for model training, alignment, and evaluation.

Model Training

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate ASR models for children’s read speech across multiple languages and accents.
  • Build pipelines for audio preprocessing, segmentation, normalization, transcription alignment, and model training.
  • Adapt existing ASR architectures such as Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, Conformer, CTC/RNN-T, or similar models for reading assessment.
  • Optimize models for practical deployment environments, including low-bandwidth, store-and-forward, server-based, and potentially offline/mobile inference.

Adopting for Reading Assessment

  • Develop approaches for accurately detecting substitutions, omissions, insertions, repetitions, partial-word attempts, hesitations and self-corrections. Implement forced alignment, phoneme-level alignment, or pronunciation-scoring approaches where required.
  • Conduct systematic error analysis by language, reading level, age, accent, gender, recording conditions, and device.
  • Collaborate with assessment experts and field teams to translate model outputs into measures such as reading accuracy, WCPM, fluency, and reading level.

Benchmarking

  • Define and track ASR metrics relevant to reading assessment, including WER/CER, word-level accuracy, error-detection precision/recall, alignment accuracy, and reading-score agreement with human evaluators.
  • Build reproducible experimentation and model-evaluation pipelines and maintain clear technical documentation.

Desired Experience and Qualification

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer with ASR expertise that can own the ASR based reading assessment pipeline across multiple languages

  • A Degree in any Mathematics/Computer Science/Data Science or related STEM field
  • 3-5 years of full-time experience; at least 2 working in an AI/ML role
  • Strong experience in automatic speech recognition, speech processing, or spoken-language technologies.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar deep-learning frameworks.
  • Experience working with modern ASR architectures and toolkits such as Hugging Face Transformers, NeMo, Kaldi, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of ASR concepts including:
    -acoustic modelling
    -CTC / transducer / encoder-decoder architectures
    -decoding and beam search
    -language models
    -forced alignment
    -phoneme representations
    -WER/CER and ASR error analysis
  • Experience preparing and working with large-scale audio and transcription datasets.
  • Ability to diagnose model errors systematically rather than relying only on aggregate transcription accuracy.

Why join us?

  • Impact at a Global Scale: Your work will directly support the learning journeys of millions of children. With programs active in 31 countries, you will help build Digital Public Goods that bridge the gap for the millions of children across the Global South who still struggle with foundational literacy.

jobs.api_description_text:
We are looking for a versatile and results-driven Full Stack AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent business applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between core AI capabilities and production-ready software—leveraging existing Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern web frameworks to solve complex enterprise challenges.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic software engineer who excels at rapid prototyping, full-stack development, and orchestrating autonomous AI agents. You should be comfortable building the "brain" of the application (RAG, Agentic orchestration) as well as the "body" (FastAPI backends, Next.js frontends, and Dockerized infrastructure).

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentic Orchestration & Skills: Develop and configure autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning. Build custom "skills" and tools that allow agents to interact with external APIs, databases, and proprietary software via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Applied AI & RAG Integration: Architect and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Optimize vector embeddings and data retrieval strategies to securely connect LLMs with enterprise data for high-accuracy outputs.

  • Full-Stack Application Development: Design and implement both frontend and backend components using Next.js and FastAPI. Build responsive user interfaces and robust core business logic to support AI-powered features.

  • Custom Software Engineering: Write clean, maintainable Python and TypeScript code to handle complex data transformations, custom node development, and system integrations that extend beyond standard library capabilities.

  • Infrastructure & Security: Package and manage AI applications using Docker for reliable distribution. Implement strict network isolation and volume mapping to ensure secure, standardized data access for locally hosted agents and services.

  • System Integration & APIs: Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs. Ensure smooth integration between AI models, internal data sources, and user-facing applications using Git-based collaborative workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field. (1–2 years of experience preferred; high-potential fresh graduates are welcome).

  • Applied AI Expertise: Proven experience utilizing LLMs to drive business value, with a deep understanding of Prompt Engineering, Tool/Function Calling, and RAG architectures.

  • Modern AI Stack: Hands-on experience with AI development frameworks such as LangChain, vector databases, and agentic platforms (e.g., OpenClaw).

  • Programming Proficiency: Strong experience in Python (FastAPI) and JavaScript/TypeScript (Next.js/React).

  • DevOps & Containerization: Working knowledge of Linux environments (CLI), Docker containerization for isolating agent environments, and Git for version control.

  • System Architecture: Solid understanding of REST API development, software design principles, and basic software testing practices (unit testing).

Nice-to-Haves

  • Advanced Orchestration: Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for standardizing secure connections between AI models and internal data.

  • Deployment Experience: Experience deploying services using container orchestration platforms in on-premise or private cloud infrastructure.

  • Workflow Automation: Experience with backend automation logic and state/memory management for long-running AI tasks.

  • UI/UX Design: Ability to design intuitive interfaces for complex AI-driven workflows.

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-caliber AI Research Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting-edge algorithmic research and high-performance system implementation. I
jobs.api_description_text:
Salary: RM 6,000 – RM 8,000 per month

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-caliber AI Research Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting-edge algorithmic research and high-performance system implementation. In this role, you will be the primary architect for optimizing the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), moving beyond treating GPUs as "black boxes" to treat them as resources to be saturated through meticulous kernel tuning and memory management.

You will focus on optimizing LLM deployment across diverse hardware profiles, from multi-GPU, multi-node high-performance server clusters to integrated GPU (iGPU) configurations in consumer-grade AI laptops. If you are a builder who thrives on squeezing every drop of performance out of silicon while maintaining model accuracy, you belong on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research & Model Development: Fine-tune pre-trained models using advanced techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF, full parameter tuning). Conduct experiments with emerging architectures like Mixture of Experts (MoE), sparse attention, and dynamic computation to enhance efficiency and safety.

  • Architectural Optimization: Optimize inference engines for long-context windows, focusing on innovative KV cache management and compression. Profile and eliminate bottlenecks across the stack, specifically optimizing data transfer between NVMe storage, system memory, and GPUs.

  • Hardware-Software Co-design: Implement advanced memory management strategies to push the boundaries of LLM serving on constrained hardware (iGPUs). Perform hardware-aware deployment to ensure maximum resource utilization.

  • Software Design & System Integration: Develop and integrate scalable RESTful APIs (FastAPI) to support reliable application interactions. Build clean, maintainable full-stack components using JavaScript/TypeScript, Next.js, and React.

  • Deployment & Containerization: Containerize complex AI workloads using Docker to ensure seamless consistency across development, testing, and production environments.

  • Collaborative Engineering: Use Git-based workflows to collaborate with cross-functional teams, ensuring all software solutions align with established architectural, development, and testing standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • AI & LLM Proficiency: Deep understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and LLM API integration.

  • Advanced AI Techniques: Proven experience or project work in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agent workflows, and multimodal Generative AI (text, voice, image).

  • Backend & Systems Programming: Strong foundation in Python (FastAPI) and JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu Server) and Nginx.

  • DevOps Fundamentals: Proficiency in Docker for containerization and Git for version control.

  • Startup Mindset: 0–2 years of experience (fresh graduates with strong project portfolios are encouraged); must have the ability to build the "first working iteration" in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Low-Level Tuning: Experience or knowledge in C++, Rust, or CUDA/Triton for kernel development and low-level performance tuning.

  • Hardware Knowledge: Preliminary understanding of hardware architecture, specifically the interplay between SSDs, CPUs, and GPUs.

  • Frontend Expertise: Experience building user-facing AI interfaces with React and Next.js.

  • Testing & Tooling: Familiarity with Postman for API testing and VS Code for streamlined development.

Due to growth, we are hiring for two AI Engineer - ML Ops to join us permanently on a hybrid working basis from our Kuala Lumpur. With this role, you will build, deploy and operate machine learning solutions on the organisation’s Databricks platform.

In this role you will report to the Head of Data Platform and Services, the role partners with data science, data engineering and product teams to turn analytical prototypes into production-grade pipelines and services that are reliable, secure and scalable.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on software quality, automation and operational excellence. The ML Engineer implements CI/CD for ML, testing, reproducibility, model monitoring and safe deployment patterns, while working within governance, security and data protection requirements for production AI services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end machine learning pipelines on Databricks, covering data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Drive continuous improvement by optimising Databricks workloads, developing reusable ML engineering components, and sharing best practices across teams.

To be successful in the role, you will have

  • Proven experience delivering ML/Analytic solutions, working across Data disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience operating Databricks or comparable lakehouse platforms, including runtime upgrades, workspace administration, access controls.
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices across the model lifecycle (CI/CD, versioning, monitoring, reproducibility)

We’re focused on our future – and we’re looking for people who want to grow with us as we take on the challenges of tomorrow. At BSI, you’ll find a workplace where everyone can flourish and thrive, where innovation is encouraged and where learning is part of your everyday. You’ll contribute to work that shapes industries and enhances lives – and you’ll take pride in what you do.

We’re looking for passionate people who want to make a difference in a purpose-led organisation. If that sounds like you, apply now. Together, we can help create a better society and a more sustainable world.

About the role

Design, build, and optimize domain-specific AI agents across multiple areas such as semiconductor design, semiconductor manufacturing, and internet products. Position : AI Application Engineer (Agent / Game Creation Platform) — Internship

Role Overview

Contribute to the R&D of the Agent system for an AI game creation platform. Building on the company's existing game editor and runtime, enable users to create and modify games through natural language. The role focuses on the Agent execution loop, tool integration, art asset automation, and reliability engineering. It does not require training or algorithmic development of underlying generative models. This position starts as an internship, and we strongly welcome applications from current Master's and PhD students.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the R&D of the Agent system for the AI game creation platform. Building on the company's existing game editor and runtime, enable users to create and modify games through natural language.
  • Contribute to the development of the Agent execution loop for game creation, including intent understanding, task planning, tool invocation, context and execution-state management, result validation, and error recovery, supporting multi-step task completion over extended interactions.
  • Collaborate with the editor and game R&D teams to encapsulate existing capabilities—such as maps, characters, skills, and gameplay rules—and integrate them into the Agent, supporting flexible configuration and composition.
  • Contribute to the game art asset generation and processing pipeline. By invoking tools or services for image generation, image editing, background removal, motion generation, video frame extraction, and sprite-sheet processing, enable automation from user requirements to usable game assets.
  • Collaborate with the art and asset-system R&D teams to complete resource-generation task orchestration, asynchronous status tracking, result validation, failure retry, and asset ingestion, and apply assets in-game through the editor.
  • Contribute to operational reliability. Handle duplicate requests, execution failures, and related issues; support task recovery, operation tracking, and undo.
  • Build Agent test cases and evaluation processes. Through experiments, log analysis, and failure-case reviews, continuously optimize task success rate, interaction experience, response speed, and invocation cost.


Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Mathematics, or a related field. Current Master's/PhD students and fresh graduates are all welcome.
  • Solid programming and computer-science fundamentals. Proficient in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, with the ability to independently complete module development, debugging, and testing.
  • Hands-on project experience with Agents, from research, internships, open source, or personal projects. Practical involvement in a multi-step task flow—"understanding user requirements, decomposing tasks, invoking tools or APIs, and continuing based on execution results"—with the ability to show code or running results and explain your own contributions, problems encountered, and how they were solved. Project experience should not be limited to Q&A applications or simple model API calls.
  • Understanding of structured output from large models, tool invocation, context management, and task planning; awareness of model capability boundaries; ability to reasonably divide responsibilities between model inference and deterministic program logic.
  • Basic software engineering and system-integration skills. Familiarity with HTTP APIs, databases, asynchronous tasks, and exception handling; ability to integrate existing business capabilities into an Agent.
  • Ability to design experiments and analyze problems: construct test cases, analyze failure causes, and validate optimization effects through controlled experiments.
  • Proactive learning, communication, collaboration, and execution skills. Willingness to deeply understand game-creation scenarios and translate technical solutions into usable product features.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Agent project experience with natural-language-driven editors, AI programming, low-code builders, design tools, or other complex business operations.
  • Project experience with image generation and editing, image processing, video or motion generation, or sprite-sheet processing.
  • Research experience in Agent planning, memory, tool use, or evaluation.
  • AI application R&D internship experience, open-source contributions, or personal projects used by real users.
  • Experience in game development, configuration-driven systems, or automated testing.

Salary: RM 10,000 – RM 13,000 per month

About the role

AI Development Engineer (MCP & Agent Direction) is responsible for engineering generative AI capabilities into film and animation production workflows, with focus on MCP toolchain construction, agent workflow orchestration, stylized rendering generation pipelines, and model distillation & compression. The role requires complete practical experience in generative models from training, evaluation to local deployment, capable of completing model compression, inference optimization and effect evaluation loops under local compute conditions, ensuring generation results are controllable, reproducible and accountable.

Key responsibilities

  • MCP server planning, development and governance: encapsulate image generation, video generation, asset retrieval, ComfyUI workflow execution, rendering data export capabilities as standard MCP tool interfaces; implement parameter specifications, permission control, cost marking and audit logs; align with MCP stateless specifications, support capability discovery, self-contained requests and standardized error handling; design MCP service interfaces for DCC integration

  • Agent workflow orchestration and implementation: support multi-step task decomposition and execution in film and animation production scenarios, support long task asynchronous execution, breakpoint continuation, failure retry and manual confirmation; implement Orchestrator-Worker, Fan-out/Fan-in, tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement capabilities; establish evaluation metrics for agent success rate, manual intervention rate, retry rate, generation consistency and single-shot cost

  • Stylized rendering generation pipeline construction: manage style model training, evaluation and version management (LoRA / Style Pack / IP-Adapter); apply structural constraints (ControlNet, depth maps, normal maps, edge maps, reference image conditions); maintain character ID consistency and inter-shot style consistency; output layered data for AI neural rendering including depth, normal, Alpha, optical flow, camera trajectory, skeleton metadata

  • Model distillation, compression and inference acceleration: design distillation schemes for image, video and multimodal generation models including teacher/student model training, step distillation, training data construction and effect evaluation; complete quantization and inference acceleration engineering covering FP8, INT4, NVFP4, GGUF, ONNX, TensorRT, vLLM solutions; establish automated evaluation system covering FID/CLIP Score, prompt adherence, temporal stability, artifact rate and single-shot generation cost

  • Local inference service deployment and resource management: containerized deployment, interface encapsulation, multi-tenant isolation, GPU memory quota management, task queue and priority scheduling; establish cost accounting mechanisms for single image, single shot, per-second video generation; monitor service health, queue congestion, failure modes and regeneration trigger conditions

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration: evaluate, integrate and orchestrate multiple third-party AI model APIs (image generation, video generation, 3D model generation, PBR material generation); design API routing strategies, load balancing and degradation schemes ensuring stability and timeliness in multi-model parallel calls

  • DCC software AI client integration: embed AI generation capabilities as plugins in DCC tools (Blender/Maya) enabling artists to call AI capabilities directly in software viewport; design and implement DCC plugin AI function modules including in-viewport AI generation preview, parameter adjustment panels, asynchronous task status monitoring; ensure AI operations integrate seamlessly with artist workflows

  • AI generated content quality evaluation system construction: establish automated quality evaluation pipeline for AI generated content including 3D model topology quality scoring, inter-frame consistency detection for video, material seamlessness checking, image style consistency assessment; establish quality gate standards ensuring AI output meets production archival threshold

  • Agent tool registry and capability discovery mechanism: design and manage MCP tool registry supporting tool version management, capability discovery, dependency declaration and compatibility verification; implement MCP Server capability declaration and auto-discovery protocol enabling AI Agent to dynamically perceive available tools and autonomously orchestrate calling chains

  • Multimodal generation pipeline design: design cross-modal AI generation pipelines (image→video→3D→material) involving format conversion between different models, condition data transmission, style consistency maintenance; design pipeline-level error handling, retry mechanisms and manual review nodes ensuring end-to-end reliability

  • Generation result reproducibility, version management and regression testing: implement model version locking, random seed recording, parameter snapshots, workflow JSON archiving and rendering manifest generation; establish regression testing mechanisms for style packs, distilled models, MCP tools and agent workflows; support version rollback and issue closure when quality, latency or cost baselines regress

  • Technology tracking and production introduction assessment: track technology progress in generative video, stylized rendering, MCP/Agent frameworks, local inference optimization; organize PoC verification and selection evaluation from quality, stability, license compliance and production adaptation dimensions providing actionable introduction recommendations

About you

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Computer Graphics or related field

  • 3+ years Python engineering development experience with service-oriented and containerized deployment practice

  • 1+ year generative model engineering experience covering at least two directions among training, evaluation, quantization, distillation or inference optimization

  • Strong English technical literature reading ability and technical documentation writing ability

  • Familiar with mainstream generative model training and inference processes including Stable Diffusion, FLUX / FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image, AnimateDiff, LTX-2, Minimax H3 or equivalent diffusion/flow matching models

  • Deep hands-on experience with ComfyUI and/or Diffusers capable of completing workflow automation execution, custom node integration, model/VAE/LoRA management, batch scheduling and VRAM optimization

  • Master model compression and inference acceleration methods, familiar with at least two of: knowledge distillation, step distillation, FP8/INT4/NVFP4 quantization, LoRA merging, TensorRT, vLLM, GGUF/ONNX export or inference acceleration frameworks

  • Familiar with style fine-tuning training process (LoRA / Style Pack) capable of independently completing data construction, overfitting discrimination, style consistency evaluation and online closure

  • Large language model application development experience, familiar with tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement, Function Calling, MCP tool registration and agent evaluation

  • Engineering judgment capability able to reasonably divide boundaries between model capabilities and rule logic, accurately attribute generation, inference and pipeline failures

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration experience with actual engineering experience integrating multiple external AI generation APIs (image/video/3D generation), capable of implementing API routing design, load balancing, degradation strategies and circuit breaker mechanisms

  • DCC software AI client integration experience with actual development experience embedding AI capabilities as plugins in Blender/Maya and other DCC tools, understanding DCC plugin development frameworks, viewport integration mechanisms and artist workflow adaptation

  • AI generated content quality evaluation system construction experience capable of designing automated quality evaluation pipelines covering 3D model quality inspection, video consistency detection, material quality assessment dimensions, establishing quantifiable quality gate standards

Role Overview

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end deployment of on-premise AI solutions. This role is a unique blend of high-performance hardware engineering and software stack orchestration. You will be the driving force behind the physical assembly of high-performance computing hardware, operating system provisioning, and the deployment of containerized AI applications.

You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for ensuring system reliability and performance at client sites, bridging the gap between raw silicon and production-ready AI models.

Key Responsibilities

  • Systems Integration: Perform full-cycle hardware assembly, including the integration of high-performance Motherboards (MB), CPUs, GPUs, and high-speed NVMe/SSD storage arrays.

  • Logistics & Hardware Management: Oversee the end-to-end logistics lifecycle of hardware assets, including inventory tracking, shipping, and coordinated onsite installation to ensure seamless customer delivery.

  • Deployment & Maintenance: Provision and configure Linux-based environments and specialized AI software stacks on-premise, ensuring environments are tuned for heavy compute.

  • Container Management: Deploy and manage AI applications using Docker, ensuring containers are optimized, resource-constrained, and running according to specification.

  • System Diagnostics: Monitor system health and perform deep-dive debugging by analyzing Docker logs, kernel logs (dmesg), and hardware telemetry to preempt failures.

  • Collaborative Troubleshooting: Isolate and resolve complex network configurations, driver conflicts (NVIDIA/CUDA), and hardware-level failures.

  • Hardware Proficiency: Deep understanding of PC/Server architecture, including CPU architectures, GPU power requirements, PCIe lane distribution, and DRAM/Storage scaling.

  • OS & Scripting: Strong command of the Linux CLI (Ubuntu/CentOS) for filesystem management, networking configuration, and shell scripting for task automation.

  • Containerization: Practical experience managing Docker environments and understanding container lifecycles.

  • Precision & Detail: High level of precision in physical assembly, including cable management, thermal application, and firmware/BIOS updates.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Orchestration: Basic understanding of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.

  • NVIDIA Stack: Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise stack and GPU operator deployments.

  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear status reports for both internal engineering teams and non-technical client stakeholders.

After the deal, you hand the solution over to our delivery team and stay involved as the customer's technical point of contact. We also offer our own AI products and platform, and you will help customers see where they fit.

• Presales and solutioning: Be the technical lead in the sales process. • 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least some work taking applications from development to production.

jobs.api_description_text:
Salary: RM 5,500 – RM 8,000 per month

About the role

We are looking for an experienced mid level QA Engineer to own the testing of a product area end to end — planning it, testing it, automating it, and standing behind what goes live.

Our QA team is at the forefront of using AI in testing. We build our own tooling: it drafts test plans and cases from requirements, runs the tests, and reports the bugs it finds. It is still growing, and you will help improve it. Nothing ships on the tooling's word alone — the engineer who owns the work reviews and approves it.

The role suits someone who thinks like a developer about how a feature is built and like a tester about how it could break.

A technical background is required: you should be able to read and understand code, and see how a feature is built from the developer's side.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Review each requirement with product owners, project managers and developers — confirm your understanding with its owner, challenge it when it is unclear, untestable or wrong, and record decisions as it changes, including those made in meetings and chat groups.

  • Write each test plan with our AI tooling, then own the cases — add what is missing, cut what is wrong, and approve the final set.

  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, Midscene and in-house API tools), and repair them when they raise false alarms or break after a product change.

  • Run progression, regression, API and stress testing — automation first, by hand where automation falls short — and add negative, abuse and exploratory testing. Diagnose each failure as a real defect, a script problem or an environment issue.

  • Run a test readiness check before testing starts — the right build, test accounts and test data in place — and flag any gaps. Then take each release through every stage — the test environment, pre-production and, once it is live, production — without affecting real users or live data.

  • Report defects with clear steps and evidence to the team responsible, escalate urgent ones and retest every fix — challenging developers when a fix, or a “not a bug” reply, is not right.

  • Share your progress daily, and publish a test report for each release: pass, fail or conditional pass, with the risks that remain.

  • Keep your cases, automation and documentation current, in the structured form our AI tooling uses, and turn every defect that reaches production into a new test case.


Job Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of hands-on software testing, including owning a module or product area end to end.

  • Testing experience on desktop web, mobile web (H5) and native iOS and Android apps, including device builds, real devices and device logs.

  • Experience creating and maintaining automated UI and API tests — not only running them — with Playwright or an equivalent framework.

  • An understanding of how software is designed and built — front end, APIs, services and data — well enough to see a feature from the developer's side and spot where it is likely to break.

  • Able to read and understand code in a common language such as Python, Java, JavaScript or C / C++ — to trace what a change does and where it could break.

  • Comfortable reading logs and API responses.

  • A track record of clear, thorough test plans and test cases.

  • Practical AI skills — you use AI tools daily, write your own prompts, and judge what they produce rather than accepting it.

  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail — quick to learn, able to work independently, and confident enough to raise concerns early.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfortable working across teams.

  • Able to support release testing when a deployment window falls outside regular office hours.

  • A Diploma or Degree in Engineering (Computer / Telecommunication), Computer Science, Information Technology or an equivalent field. Software Engineering graduates are preferred.

  • Required Language(s): English, Mandarin (you will liaise with Mandarin-speaking counterparts).


Good to have:

  • Some hands-on experience building AI agents, or the tools, instructions and workflows they run on.

  • A track record of improving how a whole team tests — finding a slow or repetitive step and making it faster for everyone.

  • Fundamentals in networking, databases, programming, system design or UI/UX design.

  • A software testing certification, such as ISTQB.


How this career will benefit you:

  • Real ownership. Your product areas are yours end to end — the plan, the cases, the automation and the call on quality.

  • An AI-first, automation-first workflow. You work with AI-assisted planning, case generation and automation every day — still rare hands-on experience.

  • A growth path. Progression into senior QA engineering or QA leadership — the step up comes from improving how the whole team works.


Benefits of this role:

  • Permanent, full-time position

  • 13th Month Salary (upon Company Declaration)

  • Project Incentive (upon Company Declaration based on project performance)

  • Competitive overtime pay for release work outside office hours

  • Transport, Meal, Birthday Allowances (upon Confirmation)

jobs.api_description_text:
What you will do

Design the flow and architecture

  • Map the current lot disposition flow with quality, product and process engineers (hold triggers, evidence gathered, decision rules, MRB, approval levels) and design the target AI-assisted flow: what is automated, what is assisted, and what stays manual.
  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture: data ingestion, feature and context layer, ML models, LLM/agent reasoning, decision workflow and audit trail.
  • Produce the High-Level Design (HLD): system context, component, data-flow and deployment views, integration landscape, and non-functional requirements such as latency, availability, security and scalability.
  • Produce and sign off the Low-Level Design (LLD): service and API contracts, data models and schemas, agent and tool definitions, model and prompt interfaces, sequence diagrams and error handling.
  • Make and document the key trade-offs (build vs buy, cloud vs on-prem, model selection) and own the architecture decision records.

Build the models and agents

  • Build agents that assemble the evidence pack for a held lot by pulling lot genealogy, SPC charts, inline and parametric data, wafer maps, test-bin summaries and equipment history through tool-calling.
  • Combine traditional ML with LLM reasoning: hold-reason classification, anomaly and excursion detection, wafer-map pattern recognition, and similarity search over historical dispositions and 8D/MRB records.
  • Generate disposition recommendations with confidence scores, cited evidence and a plain-language rationale that an engineer can verify in seconds.

Set best practices for tooling and engineering

  • Define the team's engineering toolchain and standards: repository structure, coding standards, branching and code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and environment strategy.
  • Set MLOps/LLMOps practices: experiment tracking, model registry, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, drift detection, rollback and cost tracking.
  • Set documentation standards (HLD/LLD templates, ADRs, runbooks) so the system can be supported and extended beyond the original team.

Make it safe for automotive-grade quality

  • Design the human-in-the-loop controls: confidence thresholds, approval routing, override capture, and a staged path from recommend-only to auto-release for well-understood, low-risk hold types.
  • Build full traceability into every recommendation (input data, model and prompt version, rationale and final human decision) to meet IATF 16949 and customer audit expectations.
  • Agree the evaluation bar with quality owners before anything goes live: back-testing against historical dispositions, false-release and escape-risk metrics, drift monitoring and rollback.

Lead and guide the team

  • Lead the AI engineers on the programme: break the HLD and LLD into work packages, plan delivery with the team, and unblock design questions as they come up.
  • Walk engineers through the design before development starts, run design and code reviews, and make sure what is built matches the architecture.
  • Mentor the AI engineers toward independent ownership of their components.
  • Pilot at one site, prove the impact on hold cycle time and engineering effort, then turn it into a reusable pattern for rollout across fabs and assembly & test sites.

Core requirements

  • 8+ years building ML/AI systems, with at least 2 years hands-on with LLM or agent systems.
  • Has architected and shipped an AI decision-support or automation system to production, not just a prototype.
  • Proven track record of writing HLD and LLD for production systems and leading system integration across enterprise or manufacturing systems.
  • Experience leading or technically guiding a team of engineers from design through development and release.
  • Strong traditional machine learning: classification, anomaly detection, time-series and tabular models (e.g., gradient boosting), feature engineering, and evaluation on imbalanced data.
  • Hands-on with agent frameworks or SDKs (Claude Agent SDK/MCP, LangGraph, AutoGen) or custom orchestration, and with RAG over both structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large volumes of tabular, time-series or sensor data.
  • Comfortable defining engineering best practices and tooling: CI/CD, code review, testing strategy and MLOps.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop systems where explainability, auditability and safe failure matter.
  • Able to sit with process and quality engineers, understand how they actually decide, and turn that into an architecture they trust.

We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise AI solutions involving machine learning, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agent architectures.

jobs.api_description_text:
岗位概述

我们正处于 AI 重塑金融基础设施的历史节点。作为 AI Agent 架构师，你将成为 AI 智能体系的核心构建者——不只是编写代码，而是定义下一代金融级 Agent 如何感知市场信号、规划执行路径、记忆业务上下文与跨系统协作。你将主导打造可承载真实金融场景的 Agent 体系，覆盖交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察、用户智能服务等核心业务，让 AI 在加密金融的高速、高压、高合规环境中真正自主完成复杂任务。这里没有边界模糊的分工，有的是直接影响亿级用户体验的技术决策权，以及一支对 LLM 与 Agent 技术有极高密度认知的精英工程团队。

核心职责

  1. Agent 体系架构设计：主导设计 AI 智能体架构，定义 Agent 在 Openclaw 平台上的运行模型、生命周期管理与资源隔离策略；构建支撑交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察等金融核心场景的 Agent 能力基座，确保系统在高并发、低延迟、强合规约束下稳定运行。

  2. 金融场景 Agent 工程化落地：将交易信号分析、风险识别、监管合规、智能客服等业务需求转化为可执行的 Agent 工作流；设计任务规划链路（ReAct / Plan-and-Execute）、异常回退机制与结果验证体系，推动 Agent 从 PoC 快速进入生产环境。

  3. Openclaw 平台建设与演进：深度参与 Openclaw Agent Runtime 的架构演进与性能优化；设计插件体系、能力注册中心与多 Agent 编排机制，降低业务团队接入成本，持续提升平台的扩展性与复用率。

  4. 工具生态与内部系统集成：构建标准化工具调用框架，打通 Bybit 内部交易引擎、风控系统、数据平台与外部 API；设计工具权限管控、调用链追踪与错误恢复机制，集成 MCP 等标准协议，构建金融级异构工具生态。

  5. 生产质量与可观测性体系：主导 Agent 系统的可观测性建设，包括 Trace 追踪、Evaluation 评测、成本监控与延迟治理；建立金融场景下的 Agent 质量基线与回归测试体系，持续提升系统稳定性与可解释性。

  6. 技术前瞻与团队赋能：持续追踪 Agent 领域前沿进展，将研究成果转化为 AI 工程实践；制定团队 Agent 开发规范与最佳实践，通过 Code Review、技术分享与方向评审推动团队整体 AI-native 工程能力提升。

任职要求

  1. 扎实的 LLM/Agent 工程经验：具备 3年以上 AI 系统开发经验，其中 1年以上 大型语言模型（LLM）、RAG 或 Agent 系统的生产环境落地经验；具备 Openclaw 平台的开发与优化实战经验，熟悉其 Agent Runtime 架构、插件体系与多 Agent 编排机制，能基于 Openclaw 独立完成复杂 Agent 应用的工程化落地与性能调优。

  2. 系统架构能力：具备分布式系统设计能力，熟悉微服务架构、消息队列（Kafka / RabbitMQ）、异步任务调度等工程模式；能够独立完成从需求分析、架构设计到技术选型的完整决策链路。

  3. 编程能力：熟悉至少一门后端语言（Golang / Java / Node.js）；具备 REST API 设计与 Docker / Kubernetes 容器化部署能力。

  4. LLM 核心技术理解：深入理解 Transformer 架构、Attention 机制、Prompt Engineering（CoT、Few-shot、Structured Output）；熟悉主流模型 API（OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini）及本地部署方案（Ollama、vLLM）。

  5. 工程质量意识：具备良好的代码设计习惯（设计模式、单元测试、CI/CD）；有构建 LLM 评测（Evaluation）体系或 Agent Tracing（LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse）的实战经验。

加分项

  • 有 MCTS、A\*、强化学习（RL） 与 LLM 结合的规划/推理研究或工程经验，熟悉 SFT / RLHF 训练流程。

  • 在 金融、Web3、合规 或其他高复杂度垂直领域有 Agent 系统落地经验，理解领域知识对 Agent 设计的特殊约束。

  • 有开源贡献或在 NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR 等顶会发表过 Agent / RAG / LLM 相关论文。

  • 具备 多模态（Multimodal） Agent 开发经验，包括图文理解、文档解析（PDF / 财报 / 研报）等非结构化数据处理能力。

  • 熟悉 MCP（Model Context Protocol） 或参与过 Agent 标准协议的设计与实现。

About the Role

We're at an inflection point where AI is fundamentally reshaping financial infrastructure. As an AI Agent Architect, you will be a core builder of AI's intelligent ecosystem — not just writing code, but defining how next-generation financial-grade Agents perceive market signals, plan execution paths, retain business context, and orchestrate across systems. You will lead the construction of Agent capabilities purpose-built for real financial scenarios: trading intelligence, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, and smart user services — engineered to operate autonomously in crypto finance's high-velocity, high-stakes, and high-compliance environment.This is a role with genuine technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions that directly shape the experience of hundreds of millions of users, alongside an elite engineering team with exceptional depth in LLM and Agent technology.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Agent Architecture Design: Lead the architectural design of AI's intelligent Agent layer — defining agent execution models, lifecycle management, and resource isolation strategies on the Openclaw platform. Build the foundational Agent capabilities powering core financial scenarios including trading intelligence, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring, engineered for high-concurrency, low-latency, and regulatory-grade reliability.

  2. Financial Scenario Agent Engineering: Translate complex financial use cases — trading signal analysis, risk identification, regulatory compliance, and intelligent customer service — into production-ready Agent workflows. Design task planning chains (ReAct / Plan-and-Execute), fallback and error recovery mechanisms, and result validation frameworks that accelerate the path from PoC to production.

  3. Openclaw Platform Development & Evolution: Contribute deeply to the architectural evolution and performance optimization of the Openclaw Agent Runtime. Design the plugin ecosystem, capability registry, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms to reduce onboarding friction for product teams and improve platform extensibility and reusability.

  4. Tool Ecosystem & Internal System Integration: Build a standardized tool-calling framework connecting Bybit's internal trading engine, risk systems, data platforms, and external APIs. Design tool permission controls, call-chain tracing, and error recovery; integrate standards such as MCP to unify a financial-grade heterogeneous tool ecosystem.

  5. Production Quality & Observability: Lead the observability stack for Agent systems, including trace monitoring, evaluation pipelines, cost tracking, and latency governance. Establish quality baselines and regression testing frameworks for financial Agent scenarios, continuously improving system stability and interpretability.

  6. Technical Vision & Team Enablement: Track and internalize cutting-edge Agent research, translating advances into AI engineering practice. Define team-wide Agent development standards and best practices; drive AI-native engineering capability uplift through code reviews, technical sharing, and architectural reviews.

Requirements

  1. Proven LLM / Agent Engineering Experience: 3+ years of AI systems development experience, including 1+ year of production experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, or Agent frameworks; hands-on development and optimization experience with Openclaw, including familiarity with its Agent Runtime architecture, plugin ecosystem, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms.

  2. Systems Architecture Proficiency: Strong distributed systems design skills including microservices architecture, message queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and async task scheduling; capable of independently driving the full decision chain from requirements analysis through architecture design to technology selection.

  3. Programming Expertise: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang / Java / Node.js); solid REST API design and containerized deployment skills (Docker / Kubernetes).

  4. Deep LLM Technical Understanding: Strong grasp of Transformer architecture, Attention mechanisms, and advanced Prompt Engineering (CoT, Few-shot, Structured Output); experience with major model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and local deployment solutions (Ollama, vLLM).

  5. Engineering Quality Standards: Strong software design fundamentals (design patterns, unit testing, CI/CD); hands-on experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or Agent tracing pipelines (LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse).

Nice to Have

  • Experience combining MCTS, A\*, or Reinforcement Learning (RL) with LLMs for planning and reasoning; familiarity with SFT / RLHF training pipelines.

  • Proven Agent system deployments in high-complexity vertical domains such as Finance, Web3, or Compliance, with an understanding of domain-specific constraints on Agent design.

  • Open-source contributions or publications in NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR on Agent, RAG, or LLM-related topics.

  • Experience with multimodal Agent development, including vision-language understanding and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, financial reports, research papers).

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or prior involvement in designing and implementing Agent communication standards.

    • Protect credentials, preserve user access boundaries across systems, and apply appropriate execution isolation and audit logging.

Work with product, design, IT, SRE, and business system owners; contribute code reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience with LLM tool calling, agent execution, or workflow orchestration; practical examples explaining design decisions, context and state management, and failure handling.
  • Experience integrating enterprise or third-party systems, including API contracts, data mapping, pagination, rate limits, and retries.
  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0/OIDC, authorization, role-based access control, and secure credential handling in applications.
  • Ability to build reliable asynchronous workflows using task state, concurrency control, idempotency, and recovery from partial failures.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Vue or React, including routing, state management, and reusable components. Vue 3 is preferred; willingness to adapt is essential.
  • Experience with automated and integration testing, Git, CI/CD, and Docker; ability to troubleshoot using logs and metrics and evaluate agents against representative tasks.
  • Clear communication with global, cross-functional teams and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience extending agent harnesses, SDKs, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or custom implementations.
  • Development of MCP servers, connectors, plugins, or SDKs; integrations with Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, Jira, ERP, or similar systems.
  • Experience with long-running workflows, human approval, durable task state, recovery, or agent evaluation frameworks.
  • Hands-on cloud deployment and operations experience, preferably AWS; familiarity with caching, queues, NoSQL databases, or vector search.
  • Electron development or plugins for desktop and productivity applications.

jobs.api_description_text:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Malaysia


Responsibilities:

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI applications, with a focus on Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and cloud-based AI solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong Python and backend engineering skills with practical experience building AI-powered applications, integrating LLMs with enterprise data, and deploying scalable, secure, and reliable solutions in production environments.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, or similar technologies. Develop solutions involving tool calling, task orchestration, workflow automation, and agent collaboration.
  • RAG & LLM Engineering: Build and optimize RAG pipelines, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and context management to improve response quality.
  • Python & Backend Development: Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI, or equivalent frameworks. Integrate AI capabilities with databases, enterprise applications, and external systems.
  • Cloud AI Solutions: Build and deploy AI applications using cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Integrate managed AI services and model APIs based on project requirements.
  • Production Deployment: Deploy, monitor, and maintain AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native services. Ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability beyond the proof-of-concept stage.
  • AI Evaluation & Optimization: Evaluate LLM outputs, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Implement automated testing, tracing, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Data & Model Integration: Work with LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, and structured and unstructured data sources. Apply prompt engineering, model selection, and fine-tuning techniques where appropriate.
  • Security & Reliability: Implement secure API integrations, access controls, data protection, and responsible AI practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into effective AI solutions and measurable business outcomes.


Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or backend development.
  • Strong hands-on Python development experience, including API development with FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience building Agentic AI applications, multi-agent workflows, or LLM-powered automation.
  • Practical experience developing RAG solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval techniques.
  • Experience integrating LLMs and AI services into backend applications and enterprise systems.
  • Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, application monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to deliver maintainable, production-ready code.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar agentic frameworks.
  • Experience with managed AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cosmos DB, or other vector and data storage technologies.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA.
  • Knowledge of inference optimization, model quantization, GPU utilization, or CUDA.
  • Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, observability, tracing, guardrails, and production performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with Go, TypeScript, React, or other technologies used in full-stack application development.
