About Lucidya

Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

Role Summary

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership

Key Responsibilities

Technical direction

  • Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline
  • Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale

Quality, evaluation and reliability

  • Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
  • Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
  • Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them

Team leadership and engineering practices

  • Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
  • Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring

Hands-on delivery

  • Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour
  • Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
  • Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling

Mindset and Behaviors

  • Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked
  • Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost
  • Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones
  • Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins
  • Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation

Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required
  • Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
  • LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning)
  • Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
  • Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases
  • Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems
  • Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records

Nice-to-have Qualifications

  • Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems
  • Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation
  • Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar)
  • Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively

jobs.api_description_text:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

AI Governance, Policy & Responsible Deployment

  • Define, document, and enforce Emerson AI governance policies, ethical guidelines, compliance expectations, and approval standards for Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce and Einstein
  • Review proposed AI toolsets and agent use cases across business functions for regulatory, ethical, privacy, security, and business-process readiness
  • Establish practical guardrails for agent design, topic configuration, actions, data grounding, escalation, auditability, and human oversight
  • Track evolving AI regulations, Salesforce trust guidance, and corporate policies, translating requirements into usable governance practices for delivery teams
  • Create AI risk assessment templates, model/use-case review checkpoints, exception processes, and remediation procedures for Salesforce AI deployments

Agentforce Enablement & Design Leadership

  • Advise workstream teams on Agentforce design patterns, agent topics, actions, instructions, prompt quality, hallucination prevention, and safe handoff to human users
  • Enable responsible AI innovation by helping teams move from concept to governed pilots, production readiness, and measurable business outcomes
  • Partner with Data Cloud, Data Stewardship, and Integration teams to ensure agent grounding data is accurate, permission-aware, compliant, and fit for intended use
  • Develop reusable Agentforce patterns, documentation, training materials, and playbooks to accelerate consistent adoption across Business Groups and World Areas

Audit, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Audit AI agent usage, performance, quality, compliance, bias risk, and outcome measures, coordinating remediation actions when issues are identified
  • Define AI trust and safety metrics, adoption metrics, value measures, and executive reporting for Salesforce AI capabilities
  • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Architecture, and Data teams to ensure AI controls align with Emerson enterprise policies and risk posture
  • Support post-deployment reviews, incident learnings, and continuous improvement of AI governance standards and agent operating models

Who You Are:

You are energized by helping Emerson innovate responsibly, turning emerging AI capabilities into trusted business tools (Nimble Learning; Strategic Mindset). You can diagnose risk without becoming a blocker, applying sound judgment to privacy, compliance, security, data readiness, and user experience trade-offs (Decision Quality; Manages Complexity). You communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior leaders, making AI governance practical and actionable (Communicates Effectively). You build alignment across functions that may see AI through different lenses, creating confidence that Agentforce capabilities can scale safely and deliver value (Collaborates; Builds Networks; Ensures Accountability).

For This Role, You Will Need:

Technical Skills:

  • Salesforce Agentforce concepts, including agent design, topics, actions, instructions, guardrails, grounding, human handoff, and monitoring
  • Salesforce Einstein and AI-enabled CRM capabilities, with understanding of Salesforce Data Cloud as an AI data foundation
  • AI/ML governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, model/use-case risk assessment, bias monitoring, and AI audit practices
  • Data privacy regulations and compliance considerations, including GDPR, CCPA, industry-specific requirements, and enterprise security controls
  • LLM capabilities, limitations, hallucination risk, prompt engineering concepts, retrieval/grounding patterns, and safe automation design

Interpersonal and Leadership Skills:

  • Cross-functional influence and education across business, delivery, data, security, legal, compliance, and architecture stakeholders
  • Risk assessment and mitigation planning with the judgment to distinguish acceptable experimentation from unacceptable enterprise risk
  • Clear communication of AI concepts, controls, and trade-offs to non-technical leaders and delivery teams
  • Pragmatic governance orientation that accelerates responsible innovation rather than creating unnecessary friction
  • Curiosity, regulatory awareness, and disciplined learning in a rapidly evolving AI technology landscape

Required Certifications:

  • Salesforce Agentforce certification
  • Salesforce AI Associate, Salesforce Administrator, Data Cloud, or responsible AI / AI ethics certifications valued

Preferred / Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with manufacturing, industrial, commercial, service, or channel AI use cases
  • Hands-on Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud, or CRM automation experience
  • Formal AI ethics, responsible AI, privacy, security, or compliance certification
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Trust Layer concepts, permission-aware grounding, and enterprise AI assurance practices
  • Experience designing AI governance for global, matrixed organizations

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Business, Legal/Compliance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in AI/ML governance, data ethics, compliance, risk management, enterprise technology, or Salesforce platform leadership
  • Experience defining or operating governance frameworks for AI, analytics, automation, or data-driven technology in an enterprise context
  • Strong understanding of data privacy, security, compliance, auditability, and responsible AI principles
  • Ability to translate complex AI concepts and risks into clear guidance for technical, business, legal, and executive audiences
  • Approximately 10-20% travel (global)

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best work. We recognize the importance of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement in driving business success. We strive to create an inclusive workplace that supports professional growth, encourages diverse perspectives, and enables meaningful career development across our global organization.

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com.

ABOUT EMERSON

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

No calls or agencies please.

  • Ability to work in culturally diverse and inclusive environments.

jobs.api_description_text:
Who We Are

The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC) is the world's largest beverage company, refreshing consumers worldwide for over 135 years. Our unrivaled portfolio includes more than 500 sparkling and still brands and more than 3,800 beverage choices, with iconic brands such as Coca-Cola, Sprite, Minute Maid, Schweppes, FuzeTea, Monster, and Fanta.


With over 1,500 employees, Coca-Cola Beverages Singapore, Malaysia & Brunei is a complex and well-developed organization that produces, sells, and distributes the Coca-Cola Company products across the country. Our world-class manufacturing plant in Halal Park, Bandar Enstek in Negeri Sembilan serves as our Halal production hub for Malaysia, Singapore, and Brunei.


About The Role

Location: Menara Lien Ho, Petaling Jaya

Department: Business System

Reports to: Head of Enterprise Data, AI & Decision Intelligence


What You’ll Do

The Junior AI Engineer is a hands-on, entry-level role responsible for supporting the development of practical enterprise AI solutions, including AI agents, multi-agent workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, APIs and AI-powered applications.


Working alongside the AI Engineering team, the role will use technologies such as Python, SQL, LangChain, LangGraph and FastAPI to turn AI concepts into functional solutions. The successful candidate should have strong programming fundamentals, an understanding of modern Generative AI concepts, and a demonstrated ability to learn, experiment and build working technology solutions


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain.
  • Build RAG pipelines that connect Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise data, documents and knowledge sources.
  • Develop AI services and APIs using Python and FastAPI.
  • Use SQL to retrieve, process and integrate data into AI applications.
  • Support the development of AI evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, groundedness and reliability.
  • Develop and prototype intuitive user experiences for AI-powered applications using modern development tools.
  • Support the containerization and deployment of AI applications on Azure.
  • Work closely with senior AI engineers to experiment with new AI technologies and turn ideas into functional prototypes and production-ready solutions.
  • Apply modern software-development practices, including Git/version control, testing and documentation.


What You Bring

  • Fresh graduate with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong foundation in Python programming with working knowledge of SQL.
  • Basic understanding of Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, APIs and prompt engineering.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software-development practices.
  • Able to demonstrate at least one relevant AI, software or data project, whether academic, internship, hackathon or personal.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Curious and experimental mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work alongside AI engineers and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Docker, Azure, React or vector databases would be an advantage.


Our Purpose & Growth Behavior

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We focus on five key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive, agile, and corporate entrepreneurship – and value how we work as much as what we achieve.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. When we collect your personal information as part of a job application or offer of employment, we do so in accordance with industry standards and best practices and in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

jobs.api_description_text:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Agentic AI) to join our AI Automation team, building production-grade applications that help internal users automate routine execution and focus on more complex, high-value challenges.

This is primarily a software engineering role focused on building production applications that incorporate Agentic AI and LLM-based capabilities. We are looking for someone with solid software engineering experience who is comfortable working across different parts of a modern web application and is excited about developing deeper expertise in Agentic AI.

You will work across the application stack, including Python backend services, React/TypeScript frontends, APIs, SQL databases, system integrations, and cloud infrastructure. A key part of your role will be designing and implementing the agentic LLM orchestration behind our applications and ensuring that these capabilities work reliably as part of a broader production system.

You will also contribute to how we evaluate and improve our LLM-based applications, helping us understand whether our AI systems are performing well, where they fail, and how changes to prompts, models, tools, retrieval, or application logic affect overall quality.

We expect our engineers to develop a good understanding of the problems they are solving. You will therefore be expected to learn about the market research and consulting domain, work closely with our business stakeholders, and understand their workflows, challenges, and client needs. We believe that understanding the domain is essential to building genuinely useful AI applications rather than simply applying technology to a problem.

This role involves working with global stakeholders across different time zones. From time to time, you may be required to attend meetings outside your normal working hours. We support flexible working arrangements, allowing you to adjust your working hours accordingly when this is needed.

Why join Mintel?

We are the world's leading market intelligence agency and technology underpins our success. We help our clients understand consumers and consumer markets, and we aspire to provide the market intelligence behind every great business decision. Our technology allows us to deliver data, insights, and opinions in a compelling way to our clients across the globe.

Mintel is committed to building and supporting a diverse workforce, providing opportunities for all. 22% of our Engineering team and 23% of our Engineering leaders are women. We offer flexible working options and provide support, development and growth opportunities.

We support a hybrid working approach. Most of our colleagues work three days a week in our KL office and the rest of the week remotely.

What You Will Do

  • Build, test, deploy, and maintain production full-stack applications, working across React and TypeScript frontends, Python services using FastAPI or Django, SQL databases, APIs, authentication, and system integrations.
  • Design and implement Agentic AI capabilities, including LLM orchestration, tool use, workflows, retrieval, structured outputs, and other patterns required to integrate generative AI into production applications.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of LLM and Agentic AI systems, helping define evaluation datasets and meaningful quality criteria, implementing automated evaluations, analysing failures and regressions, and using the results to improve system performance.
  • Contribute to technical design and system architecture, considering factors such as maintainability, scalability, reliability, security, performance, and observability.
  • Deploy and operate applications in cloud environments, contributing to CI/CD, application configuration, monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and production support. Our applications primarily operate in AWS.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the market research and consulting domain, working with consultants and other business stakeholders to understand their workflows, the problems they solve for clients, and where AI and automation can provide meaningful value.
  • Translate business problems into practical technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and helping them understand what is technically feasible.
  • Develop features and solve technical problems as part of an Agile team, working independently where appropriate while also pairing and collaborating with other Engineers and Architects.

We are looking for an AI-Native Backend Engineer to build the core infrastructure powering our next-generation AI and agentic systems.

This is not a traditional backend role.

You will design and build the backend foundation for AI-driven products, agents, workflows, and SaaS systems—connecting APIs, data, models, tools, and retrieval systems into one scalable architecture.

If you are excited about AI engineering, backend systems, and building intelligent automation at scale, this role puts you at the center of it.

🚀 What You’ll Do

  • Design and build AI-native backend systems (agent orchestration, tool calling, routing, memory, and workflow execution)

  • Develop scalable backend services using Node.js, Python, PHP, JavaScript, and SQL

  • Build and maintain APIs connecting SaaS modules, internal systems, external services, and AI model providers

  • Implement AI capabilities including prompt management, retrieval systems, embeddings, memory control, and structured outputs

  • Design agent workflows (planner, router, executor, verifier, fallback, escalation, human approval flows)

  • Build reusable backend services for permissions, logging, evaluation, and workflow state tracking

  • Handle data systems including databases, queues, async processing, and vector storage

  • Optimize backend performance for high-volume APIs, background jobs, and AI inference workloads

  • Ensure reliability, security, observability, and cost efficiency of AI systems

  • Participate in full SDLC: architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and improvement

  • Collaborate with Product, AI, FDE, and Support teams to deliver scalable AI solutions

  • Identify risks in AI systems such as hallucinations, data leakage, latency, cost, and performance issues

🧠 Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related field

  • 2+ years experience in Backend Engineer / AI Engineer / API Engineer / Platform Engineer / Full Stack Engineer roles

  • Strong backend development skills in Node.js, Python, PHP, Java, or Ruby

  • Strong knowledge of SQL, database design, APIs, authentication, and system architecture

  • Understanding of event-driven architecture, microservices, queues, and async processing

  • Solid understanding of AI/agentic concepts:

    • Prompt engineering

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Embeddings & vector databases

    • Tool calling & orchestration

    • Memory systems & structured outputs

    • Evaluation & guardrails

  • Familiar with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, logging, monitoring

  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to AI reliability, scalability, and security

  • Good communication skills to explain technical architecture clearly

  • Able to manage multiple backend and AI system initiatives

⭐ Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) or local model deployment

  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, MCP, or agent frameworks

  • Exposure to AI product development or automation platforms

  • Experience in production-scale backend systems or platform engineering

📈 Why Join Us

You’ll be building AI-native systems from the ground up, not just adding AI to existing software.

This is a high-ownership role where you will shape:

  • How AI agents behave

  • How workflows are executed

  • How data and tools are connected

  • How reliable and scalable our AI systems are

Your work will directly power both internal operations and customer-facing AI products.

📊 Career Growth Path

AI-Native Backend Engineer → Senior AI Backend Engineer → AI Backend Architect → AI Platform Lead → IT Manager

📩 How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short note on your experience in AI backend systems, APIs, or agentic workflows.

Job Purpose *

The Generative AI Tech Lead is responsible for leading the technical delivery, engineering quality, and day-to-day execution of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across CIMB. The role acts as the primary technical leader for a team of Generative AI Engineers and Senior Generative AI Engineers, ensuring that AI solutions are architected, built, tested, deployed, and operated in line with CIMB’s enterprise technology standards, AI governance expectations, regulatory obligations, security requirements, and business value objectives.


This role bridges hands-on engineering and technical leadership. The Tech Lead is expected to provide strong technical direction, review solution designs, guide engineering implementation, unblock delivery challenges, enforce reusable engineering patterns, and ensure that GenAI applications are reliable, scalable, secure, explainable, cost-effective, and fit for enterprise adoption. The role also works closely with AI architects, platform teams, product owners, delivery leads, risk/compliance stakeholders, and business users to translate business problems into production-grade GenAI solutions.


Key Responsibilities *

  1. Technical Leadership and Solution Delivery
  • Lead the technical execution of Generative AI and Agentic AI projects from discovery through production deployment.
  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership to Generative AI Engineers and Senior Generative AI Engineers, ensuring delivery quality, engineering discipline, and alignment to approved solution architecture.
  • Break down complex business requirements into technical solution components, engineering tasks, integration patterns, implementation plans, and delivery milestones.
  • Own technical design decisions for assigned GenAI initiatives, including LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, agent workflows, model integration, API design, system integration, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Act as the first-level technical escalation point for implementation issues, deployment challenges, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and solution defects.
  • Ensure that engineering delivery is aligned to CIMB’s non-functional requirements, including security, scalability, resilience, maintainability, latency, accuracy, cost optimisation, and operational supportability.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into AI‑enabled solutions that meet enterprise business value targets.
  1. GenAI Engineering, Architecture and Reusable Patterns
  • Design and guide the implementation of enterprise-grade GenAI applications, including LLM-powered copilots, knowledge assistants, workflow automation agents, document intelligence solutions, and AI-enabled decision-support tools.
  • Lead the use of advanced GenAI engineering techniques, including prompt engineering, prompt chaining, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, embedding strategies, context optimisation, tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, grounding, evaluation, and fallback handling.
  • Define reusable technical components, templates, libraries, prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, guardrail approaches, and reference architectures to accelerate delivery across multiple GenAI use cases.
  • Review and improve engineering designs for APIs, microservices, cloud-native deployments, CI/CD pipelines, model invocation patterns, caching, logging, monitoring, tracing, and error-handling strategies.
  • Drive technical consistency across GenAI projects by ensuring engineers follow approved coding standards, architecture principles, secure development practices, documentation expectations, and operational readiness checklists.


  1. Governance, Risk, Responsible AI and Production Readiness
  • Ensure that GenAI solutions are implemented in accordance with CIMB’s governance, risk, compliance, security, privacy, model risk, and responsible AI requirements.
  • Guide engineers in implementing appropriate controls for data protection, prompt safety, hallucination mitigation, content filtering, model documentation, explainability, traceability, auditability, and human-in-the-loop review where required.
  • Ensure that GenAI solutions include appropriate evaluation frameworks, test cases, quality metrics, regression testing, model behaviour testing, and business validation mechanisms prior to production deployment.
  • Work with governance, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, data privacy, and architecture teams to support solution review, risk assessment, and approval processes.
  • Ensure production GenAI systems are supportable, observable, and operationally ready, including runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, incident response mechanisms, and performance baselines.


  1. People Leadership, Coaching and Engineering Capability Building
  • Manage, coach, and develop Generative AI Engineers at all tenures
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, prompt reviews, architecture walkthroughs, testing reviews, and production readiness reviews.
  • Provide structured mentoring to engineers on GenAI solution design, LLM behaviour, debugging, evaluation, cloud deployment, security considerations, engineering quality, and responsible AI practices.
  • Support performance development conversations by providing objective feedback on delivery quality, technical capability, engineering maturity, collaboration, and problem-solving effectiveness.
  • Build team capability by establishing communities of practice, internal technical sharing sessions, reusable knowledge assets, implementation playbooks, and engineering standards.
  • Promote a culture of experimentation, disciplined delivery, continuous learning, engineering excellence, and responsible innovation.


Key Dimension of Impact *

Financial

  • Influences cost optimisation of GenAI workloads through efficient model selection, prompt optimisation, caching, architecture decisions, compute utilisation, and cloud resource management.
  • Accelerates time-to-market for high-impact enterprise GenAI use cases by improving engineering reuse, delivery quality, and technical execution discipline.
  • Reduces rework and production defects by strengthening technical review, testing, architecture alignment, and production readiness practices.
  • Supports value realisation from GenAI investments by ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, maintainable, and aligned to business outcomes.

Non‑Financial

  • Improves reliability, security, maintainability, and operational maturity of enterprise GenAI applications.
  • Raises engineering capability across the Generative AI Labs through coaching, mentoring, standards, reusable assets, and disciplined technical governance.
  • Strengthens CIMB’s responsible AI implementation by embedding governance, explainability, safety, auditability, and risk controls into GenAI delivery.
  • Improves cross-functional confidence in GenAI delivery by ensuring transparent communication, strong technical leadership, and production-grade solution quality.


Job Specification *

Qualifications

(Basic Degree/Diploma etc)


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field.

Professional Qualification and/or Regulatory, Licensing requirements

Certifications in AI/ML, cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, or MLOps are advantageous.


Relevant Work Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or related technology delivery roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, deploying, and operating GenAI/LLM-based systems.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams, conducting design and code reviews, managing technical delivery, and mentoring engineers.
  • Experience in financial services, regulated industries, enterprise technology environments, cloud-native platforms, and production AI systems is highly advantageous.


Required Competencies and Skills *

Competencies/Skills

(Essential to succeed in this job)


Technical / Functional

  • Deep expertise in architecting and implementing LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, prompt chaining, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and agent workflows.
  • Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, failure modes, latency/cost trade-offs, grounding strategies, safety patterns, and production reliability considerations.
  • Ability to design end-to-end GenAI systems including frontend/backend integration, APIs, microservices, orchestration layers, caching, content moderation, logging, monitoring, CI/CD, observability, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Practical experience with cloud-native AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, open-source LLM ecosystems, containerised deployments, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices including secure coding, code quality, test automation, version control, release management, API standards, design patterns, and production support.
  • Strong understanding of governance, responsible AI, data privacy, cybersecurity, model risk, explainability, traceability, auditability, and regulatory considerations for enterprise AI solutions.


Personal / Leadership

  • Ability to lead engineers day-to-day, assign technical work, review outputs, unblock delivery issues, and maintain high engineering standards.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring capability, especially in developing junior and senior engineers into stronger GenAI practitioners.
  • Ability to influence solution direction, challenge weak designs, make pragmatic technical decisions, and balance innovation with enterprise controls.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across product, business, architecture, platform, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and operations teams.

You will work closely with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to turn research and experimentation into scalable, reliable AI capabilities, owning the engineering decisions that ensure performance, safety, and cost efficiency at scale.

jobs.api_description_text:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop systems that classify records into meaningful categories, such as bank transactions, records and financial data/metrics. You will improve classification accuracy across diverse transaction, descriptions and languages, and deploy reliable solutions for production use.


Key Responsibilities

· Build and maintain models that classify records, transactions into predefined categories and subcategories.

· Process records based on descriptions (merchant names, merchant category codes, decriptions and other relevant attributes).

· Develop text preprocessing, merchant normalization, feature engineering, and classification pipelines.

· Collaborate with business teams to define category taxonomies and consistent labelling guidelines.

· Prepare labelled datasets, resolve ambiguous labels, and improve data quality.

· Address imbalanced categories, limited labelled data, unseen merchants, and changing transaction patterns.

· Evaluate models using precision, recall, F1 scores, and confusion matrices, including results by category.

· Establish confidence thresholds and fallback approaches for uncertain predictions, including human review.

· Deploy and monitor classification services, balancing accuracy, latency, and operating cost.

· Incorporate user corrections and reviewer feedback into model improvement workflows.

· Apply privacy and security controls when handling sensitive financial data.


Required Qualifications

· Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

· 1 years of relevant experience in machine learning or applied data science.

· Strong Python and SQL skills.

· Hands-on experience with supervised classification and natural language processing.

· Proficiency with tools such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or gradient boosting libraries.

· Experience working with noisy text, imbalanced datasets, and multiclass or hierarchical classification.

· Ability to design evaluation datasets that prevent data leakage and assess performance on unseen merchants and future transactions.

· Experience deploying models and building reproducible training and inference pipelines.

· Strong communication skills and the ability to explain classification errors and tradeoffs to business stakeholders.

· Cleanse and standardize raw records and transaction data, including handling missing values, duplicates, inconsistent formats, incorrect data types, and noisy descriptions.

· Develop automated data quality checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and uniqueness across training and production datasets.

· Investigate data quality issues, identify their root causes, and collaborate with data owners to implement corrections.

· Monitor input data quality and detect changes that may affect classification accuracy.


Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with banking, payments, personal finance, or transaction enrichment data.

· Familiarity with merchant identification, entity resolution, and multilingual transaction descriptions.

· Experience combining business rules, merchant mappings, and machine learning models.

· Experience with embeddings, transformer models, active learning, or weak supervision.

· Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, and cloud deployment.

· Experience in data cleansing, data validation, and data quality checking using Python and SQL.

Get to Know the Team

In the ACE (Online Deliveries, Omni-commerce) Data Science team, you are at the core of Grab's largest business pillars. We build and deploy AI/ML models to power seamless user experiences across the food ecosystem — from instant deliveries to restaurant reservations. Our mission is to enhance user satisfaction and platform efficiency by solving unique challenges in geospatial demand, proactive reliability, and transformative AI-driven discovery.

You will report to our Senior Data Science Manager and based onsite in our office in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

Get to Know the Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will lead the development of intelligent systems that shape how millions of users interact with Grab. You will move beyond basic forecasting to build proactive, "self-healing" reliability systems and leverage Generative AI to redefine the user experience.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will be working on machine learning engineering projects on one or a few areas below:

  • Strategic Demand Shaping: Architect solutions that steer demand toward higher serviceability. You will design spatial and temporal nudges — such as shifting users from on-demand to scheduled delivery models or redirecting orders from supply-constrained to under-utilized merchants — to maximize network throughput and balance platform capacity in real time.
  • Grab Content Enrichment: Transform "thin" or unstructured data into rich, machine-readable metadata. You will build systems that power new in-app discoveries and serve external AI demands (e.g., ChatGPT or Google's AI search).
  • Demand Generation & Growth: Identify "hidden" customer patterns across food and dining to unlock new demand for ACE.
  • Reliability & Dispute Arbitration: Predict friction before it happens. You will develop models to identify order risks and cancellation probabilities, automating "who is at fault" logic and facilitating proactive interventions to maintain platform trust.
  • Transformative GAI Experience: Lead the integration of Generative AI (GAI) to fundamentally evolve the current user journey and interface.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Extract Insights: Analyze massive datasets (transactional, behavioral, and geospatial) to decode food ordering patterns and optimize the end-to-end journey for food ordering journey.
  • Build, Iterate, and Deploy: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models, translating tens of millions of eaters interactions into production-grade solutions through rigorous A/B testing and monitoring.
  • Cross-Function Collaboration: Partner with product managers, engineers, analytics, design and operations teams to scale solutions.
  • Innovation: Contribute to team's innovation and IP creation

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree with 4+ years of relevant experience in Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or Operations Research.
  • Technical Depth: Deep understanding of ML/DL foundations, optimization algorithms, and data mining. Proficiency in frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. Proven experience in the application of Large Language Models
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python or Scala.
  • Problem Solving: Translate complex business problems (like multi-party dispute arbitration or spatial demand shaping) into scalable math/code solutions.
  • Soft Skills: Motivated to learn and is able communicate by articulating technical insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

jobs.api_description_text:
Every day, a distributor in the Klang Valley gets hundreds of orders on WhatsApp: voice notes, photos of handwritten lists, PDF POs. Someone retypes them into AutoCount, SQL Accounting or SAP B1. MAIA turns those messages into clean orders inside the customer’s ERP.The hard part isn’t the AI. It’s the mess. Meat sold by the kg but ordered by the carton. Customers calling one item by three names. Tax exemptions that change by buyer. Five ERP versions that each behave differently. That’s your job.
What you’ll own
  • Sit with clients, on site or on calls, and map how orders really flow, not what the SOP says
  • Turn that into a solution design: workflow, ERP data mapping, edge cases, and what our core covers versus what needs building
  • Build the customisation yourself (Python, SQL, our ERPNext/Frappe base, AI coding tools) and get it through UAT
  • Spot patterns across clients and push them into the core product, so the next client goes live faster
  • Work directly with our CTO and Head of Product
You’re probably
  • 3–6 years implementing or integrating ERP or accounting systems: SAP Business One, AutoCount, SQL Accounting, Odoo, ERPNext, Dynamics BC or similar
  • Comfortable writing SQL, Python and API integrations. You don’t need to be a senior software engineer. We care more that you ship fast with AI tools.
  • Fluent in how distributors and manufacturers run: SO, DO, invoices, UOM, price lists, credit limits
  • Bonus: MyInvois integration experience, Frappe apps, or real work shipped with Claude or Cursor. BM or Mandarin is a plus for client sites.
Not for you if you want months of specs before anything gets built, or you’d rather never meet a customer.
What you get: RM7,000–10,000/month. [Hybrid, Klang Valley plus client sites.] Your designs go live at 30+ Malaysian companies, at the front line of applied AI in B2B.
!!! To apply: in your application or message, tell us in 5 lines about the messiest ERP integration you’ve delivered: what broke and how you fixed it.
